kpis.description_fr: US Pharma = ~90 % du CA McKesson. Distribution drugs aux pharmacies + hôpitaux + retail (CVS, RAD acquisition). Top 1 USA.
kpis.description_en: US Pharma = ~90% of McKesson revenue. Drug distribution to pharmacies + hospitals + retail (CVS, RAD acquisition). #1 USA.

kpis.description_fr: ~6 M prescriptions distribuées /jour aux pharmacies USA. KPI volume cœur. Logistics scale = avantage compétitif.
kpis.description_en: ~6M prescriptions distributed daily to US pharmacies. Core volume KPI. Logistics scale = competitive advantage.

kpis.description_fr: Specialty = drugs spécialisés (oncology, biologiques GLP-1, immunology). Croissance forte mix GLP-1 + biologics. Marges supérieures.
kpis.description_en: Specialty = specialty drugs (oncology, biologics, GLP-1, immunology). Strong growth from GLP-1 + biologics mix. Higher margins.

kpis.description_fr: International = Canada + Europe (post-cession Rexall Canada 2023, exit Russie + UK 2022). Réduction footprint post-restructuration.
kpis.description_en: International = Canada + Europe (post Rexall Canada divest 2023, Russia + UK exits 2022). Reduced footprint post-restructuring.

kpis.description_fr: ~18 Mds $ buybacks + dividendes 5 ans = ~25 % market cap. Discipline retour actionnaires forte.
kpis.description_en: ~$18B buybacks + dividends 5 years = ~25% of market cap. Strong shareholder return discipline.

notes: McKesson fiscal year se termine fin mars (FY25 = avr 2024-mar 2025).
